com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence
 
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.account - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.account
PostgreSQL implementation of the account token port, over the account_tokens table.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.clientauth - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.clientauth
PostgreSQL implementation of the client assertion replay registry, over the client_assertion_jtis table.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.clients - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.clients
JDBC-backed registered clients, authorizations and consents of the authorization server.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.dev - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.dev
Development-only data: the dev profile seeds a demo user and the BFF client.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.keys - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.keys
PostgreSQL implementation of the signing key port, over the signing_keys table.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.mfa - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.mfa
PostgreSQL implementations of the multi-factor ports: security events, second-factor attempts and the per-user enforcement flag, over the security_events, second_factor_attempts and users tables.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.ott - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.ott
PostgreSQL implementations of the one-time token ports: the codes of the email and SMS one-time code login (over the ott_codes table) and the Spring Security one-time token service of the magic links (over the one_time_tokens table).
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.passkeys - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.passkeys
PostgreSQL implementation of the passkey port over the user_credentials and user_entities tables of Spring Security's official WebAuthn schema, plus the beans of Spring's own JDBC credential and user entity repositories that the WebAuthn filters use.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.password - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.password
PostgreSQL implementation of the user account port, over the users, user_authorities and user_passwords tables.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.sms - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.sms
PostgreSQL implementations of the SMS ports: the verified phone numbers and the phone verifications in progress (both over the user_phones table) and the SMS cost ledger (over the sms_cost_ledger table).
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.social - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.social
JDBC adapters of social login: the identities of external providers linked to accounts, the mark of the accounts that only hold a generated password, and the Jackson module of the federated principals.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.tokens - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.tokens
PostgreSQL support for OAuth 2 authorizations: clean-up of user authorizations and refresh token reuse detection.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.totp - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.totp
PostgreSQL implementations of the TOTP credential and recovery code ports, over the totp_credentials and recovery_codes tables.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.x509 - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.x509
JDBC adapter of X.509 client certificate sign-in: the certificates bound to accounts.
